title: Clear - Array
content:
Member of:  All Arrays

Removes all items from the array, reducing it to a 0-length array.

Syntax:
Function Clear() native

Parameters:
None

Return Value:
None

Examples:
MyStringArray.Clear()

; In this case, ["Hello", "world"] would become []
